description_en: Every morning, the soothing melody of Buddhist devotional songs resonates the surroundings of the Bhajana Sataḥ.The rest house’s name, Dīpaṅkara Jñānamālā (lit. garland of wisdom) Bhajana Sataḥ, comes from its construction as a tribute to Dīpaṅkara, the primordial Buddha enshrined at the Āḥjudyaḥ Bāhāḥ (BKT0210), which stands in front of it at the Kvāṭhaṇḍau Ṭola in Bhaktapur. Although colloquially referred to as aphalcā, the north-facing rest house is, in fact, asataḥin its structural essence. Thesataḥ's first floor serves as a repository for musical instruments and assorted items of significance. On the ground floor, a resplendent statue of Lokeśvara holds a dignified presence.The inception of thesataḥdates back to the year 1849 CE (NS 970). The benevolent patrons behind this creation were Bhājulāya Buddhācārya (text: Buddhācāyya Bhājulāya) and his wife, Pamalachimi, both from the Paśupati Mahāvihāra, Pasu Bāhāḥ (BKT0220). Their devotion extended beyond just thesataḥ's construction; they undertook the restoration of thehitilocated within the premises of the Āḥjudyaḥ Bāhāḥ. A synergy of communal effort emerged as locals generously contributed both funds and labor to renovate thesataḥin 2008 CE (NS 1128).In this sacred space, Buddhist devotional songs (bhajana) gracefully resound each morning. Orchestrating these melodious offerings is an organization named ‘Śrī Dīpaṅkara Ārya Nāmasaṃgīti Jñānamāla Bhajana Maṇḍala,’ which was established in 1961 CE (VS 2018). This dedicated group diligently coordinates the dailybhajanaperformances and the performers are bestowed with light refreshments supported by communal donations.
description_ne: नेसं नेसं ९७० (सन् १८४९) मा निर्माण गरिएको यस सतःमा प्रत्येक दिन बिहान बौद्ध भजन गरिन्छ ।भक्तपुरको क्वाथण्डौं टोलमा रहेको आःजुद्यः बाहाः (BKT0210) को सामुन्ने यो सतः रहेको छ । स्थानीयहरूले फल्चा भनेपनि खासमा यो सतः नै हो । उत्तराभिमुख गरी बनाइएको यस सतःको पहिलो तलामा भजनसँग सम्बन्धित बाजागाजा र अन्य सामग्रीहरू भण्डारण गरिएका छन् । भुइँतलामा लोकेश्वरको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ ।यो सतः नेसं ९७० (सन् १८४९) मा आःजुद्यः बाहाःमा स्थापना गरिएको दीपङ्कर बुद्धको नाममा पशुपति महाविहार, पसु बाहाः (BKT0220) ‍निवासी बुद्धाचाय्य (बुद्धाचार्य) भाजुलायले श्रीमती पमलछिमिसँग मिलेर निर्माण गरेका थिए । सतः निर्माण गर्ने क्रममा आःजुद्यः बाहाः परिसरमा रहेको हिति पनि जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । नेसं ११२८ (सन् २००८) मा स्थानीयहरूसँग चन्दा उठाएर, स्थानीयहरूले श्रमदान गरेर सतःको जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो ।यो सतःमा प्रत्येक दिन बिहान बौद्ध भजन गरिन्छ । भजन गर्नको लागि श्री दीपंक आर्य नामसंगीति ज्ञानमाला भजनमण्डल नामक संस्था गठन गरिएको छ । विसं २०१८ (सन् १९६१) मा गठन गरिएको यस संस्थाले स्थानीयहरूसँग चन्दा उठाएर जलपानको व्यवस्था गरी भजन सञ्चालन गरिरहेको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Bhājulāya Buddhācārya (text: Buddhācāyya Bhājulāya) and his wife, Pamalachimi, both from the Paśupati Mahāvihāra, Pasu Bāhāḥ (BKT0220) constructed thesataḥ. They also undertook the restoration of thehitilocated in the Āḥjudyaḥ Bāhāḥ courtyard.
Locals generously contributed both funds and labor to renovate thesataḥ.
Śrī Dīpaṅkara Ārya Nāmasaṃgīti Jñānamāla Bhajana Maṇḍala was formed for the perfromance of devotional songs at thesataḥ.
